decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording independent LED and sensor power control and removing the obsolete complete-rail LED shutdown behavior.
Independent LED and sensor power control does not necessarily change the specified sensor-board connector matrix or pinouts.
The power-control change is unrelated to the panel reset connector and its EN-to-GND behavior.
The source does not change the LED-board count, layout, or unresolved LED part selection.
Independent power control does not alter the SPS30 SEL connection or I2C operating mode.
The source does not affect the panel button and switch connectors or GPIO assignments.
The source does not modify the requirement to provide a PIR sensor input connector.
The source does not change either capacitive-touch connector, sensor, or GPIO assignment.
The source does not specify a change to the interboard power topology, connectors, or pinout.
Independent LED and sensor power control does not by itself entail any change to the interboard signal connectors or pin assignments.
The source concerns LED and sensor power control and does not change standalone USB operation of the 3.3V rail.
Separating LED and sensor power control does not remove or change the requirement to monitor both the 3.3V and 5V rails.
